title: Realtime payload-minimization and amplification supplement
safety_limits: synthetic event identities and bounded local load only; no customer or patient payload
no GitHub mutation, product execution, runtime connection, SQL execution, deployment, or production operation
no production fan-out, load test, or externally reachable subscriber

eligibility.required_runtime: isolated event broker, synthetic publisher/subscribers, and bounded load profile

cases.attack_or_failure: attempt to make an event carry a synthetic customer row, display label, amount, query text, or secret-shaped canary
cases.expected_result: event contains only opaque scoped identity, version, reason, and safe correlation fields
cases.evidence_to_pass: schema allowlist and captured-payload canary scan

cases.attack_or_failure: vary unauthorized scope identifiers and observe acknowledgement size, timing, group count, or replay cursor
cases.expected_result: uniform denial leaks neither scope existence nor event volume
cases.evidence_to_pass: bounded side-channel comparison over existing and absent synthetic scopes

cases.attack_or_failure: publish a bounded synthetic burst with duplicate keys and one hot scope to trigger reconnect and refetch amplification
cases.expected_result: coalescing/backpressure preserves the latest required version without unbounded queue, connection, or query growth
cases.evidence_to_pass: declared load profile with queue, reconnect, refetch, memory, and dropped-signal measurements

cases.attack_or_failure: inject a URL, query, table name, or arbitrary cache key into an otherwise valid event envelope
cases.expected_result: client maps registered opaque identities to fixed handlers and never executes supplied routing/query text
cases.evidence_to_pass: negative schema corpus and handler-dispatch trace

cases.attack_or_failure: force malformed synthetic events into retry, dead-letter, alert, and trace sinks
cases.expected_result: diagnostics retain event identity/version/reason but redact payload, connection material, and foreign-scope detail
cases.evidence_to_pass: sink inventory and recursive synthetic-canary scan

cases.attack_or_failure: send just-over-limit, deeply nested, duplicate-field, and compression-ratio-bomb synthetic frames
cases.expected_result: transport rejects before allocation/fan-out, records a safe bounded reason, and keeps healthy scoped traffic available
cases.evidence_to_pass: memory/CPU ceilings, rejection counters, and unaffected control-subscriber trace
